## Outline

- Change detection with UAS: applications, and the components of a difference between two surveys (real change, registration error, noise)
- Pre-processing: radiometric normalization, horizontal and vertical co-registration, and surveys without ground control
- Pre-classification methods: image and index differencing, the DEM of Difference, and multitemporal transformations
- Uncertainty: stable surfaces, NMAD, the level of detection, and significant change
- Object based and post-classification methods: from-to matrices and how classification errors combine
- Applications in geomorphology, vegetation monitoring, and infrastructure

- [Digital change detection techniques using remotely-sensed data](https://doi.org/10.1080/01431168908903939), Singh, International Journal of Remote Sensing 10(6), 1989
- [Rapid-DEM: Rapid Topographic Updates through Satellite Change Detection and UAS Data Fusion](https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14071718), White et al., Remote Sensing 14(7), 2022
- [r.dem](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass85/manuals/addons/r.dem.html) toolset manual: co-registration, DEM of Difference, bias correction, and level of detection in GRASS
